breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet and Periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly identified this conflict and also removed the periodic condition, only including the correct Dirichlet conditions: 'Dirichlet, u(0,t)=0 and u(1,t)=0'.
